items.text: Hey Cultists,
As you may know, Steam recently implemented a system to separate achievements.
This is a small update to let you know that we have separated Woolhaven DLC achievements from base game achievements, and hopefully you should be able to see these separately now after the change.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/41c2976769cea3ebb4d8cc355af901813ac3b5fb.png"]
Also, a reminder! As you may know if you have been playing Cult of the Lamb for a while, an in-game event called the Blood Moon Festival takes place between the dates of October 24th-November 10th.
To experience this, simply make sure your system date/time settings are correctly set.
After performing the Blood Moon Ritual, ghosts will linger around the base for 3 days. Catch the ghosts to unlock Follower Forms and Decorations!
Follower forms: Cursed Crow, Vampiric Demon, or Skeletal Deer
Decorations: Blood Moon Candle, Blood Moon Skull, Blood Moon Tree, or Blood Moon Pumpkin
[p align="start"]If all the items have been unlocked, catching ghosts will give you 3 Divine Inspiration points instead.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/44104b7ba353f59d50cb80222022f0ca02c4b6ec.png"]

This patch adds a huge host of changes, tweaks, and bug/crash/softlock fixes to Cult of the Lamb.
Added ability to clear dead followers from the dead follower list at Ratau’s Shack
Removed the level cap
Spies have had a rework - you may now catch, murder, or indoctrinate them if you catch them before they leave.
Children of Jalala, Rinor and Yarlen will not be abominations
Bishop Followers will no longer have the Poet Trait
Leshy will have a ‘blind’ trait
Followers on missionaries may show in dungeons
Teddy Dog Follower Form, Leafy Sculpture, Mushroom Candle, Goat Effigy, Goat Statue, and Goat Plant have been added to the Mystic Sellers Wheel.
Various further changes and tweaks
New languages added: Italian, Turkish, French Canadian and Dutch, Arabic
Fixed hundreds of bugs - so many, we don't have the word limit to include them. Below are some highlights!
Fixed soft lock during a drum circle mini game
Fixed swapping a Blunderbuss with another weapon type which resets bullet count to 3
Fixed followers appearing in idle at the knucklebones building upon spawning in the cult
Fixed Tarot Cards being drawable outside of Clauneck’s Room when a character exits at the exact same time
Fixed players becoming stuck in a locked room after defeating all enemies in Anchordeep
Fixed missing options to sacrifice followers or return to the cult in the resurrection room
Fixed players being pushed out of bounds when claiming sin at the bottom of the map near structures
Fixed followers dying out of bounds while roaming near map edges
Fixed The Goat spawning out of bounds when entering nodes
Fixed heavy attacks becoming disabled if triggered at the exact moment the player is hit
Fixed mini-bosses becoming invincible after resurrecting from corrupted rooms
Fixed knucklebones animations persisting when summoning a follower who was playing at another structure
Fixed players remaining in an undead state when killed by a bomb immediately after clearing a room
Fixed a soft lock caused by pressing both Take and Recycle on a weapon pedestal
Fixed players spawning in the temple with inverted controls or lingering blurry SFX after building it in co-op
Fixed corpses dropped near map edges being unpickable
Fixed camera issues on Smugglers’ Sanctuary bridge when interacting with the crab skin
Fixed an issue preventing the Godhood achievement from unlocking
Fixed severe framerate drops when followers offer quests in large cults
Fixed a soft lock occurring after closing the doctrines menu on macOS
Fixed undead followers becoming invincible after dying from poison
Fixed players getting stuck while claiming bonuses at boost shrines placed against map edges
Various fixes for instances that would cause the game to crash.

Alongside this patch to the base game, we also released Woolhaven, a brand new story expansion to Cult of the Lamb. If you're looking to delve deeper into the contents of the DLC, you can find our community update for that here.

items.text: Thank you to everyone who has been reporting your bugs! We are on hands working to fix any bugs you come across.
If you do find any, please either report them using the in-game bug report function (by clicking the bug icon in the pause menu), or you can also use the Steam discussions.
We will crush the bugs swiftly, and with pain.
